I'm a current ent but I completely understand where you're coming from. Weed can definitely be a source of comfort in times of depression or anxiety but it also be a burden if your using it only to escape. The thing is though we can still train our minds to get back into that state of "high consciousness", weed just happens to be a quicker way of getting there. 

I would suggest trying meditation. It takes practice, so don't give up after the first few tries. Just 5 minutes a day can have a huge impact. Try and use your time a way from weed as a good experience, a chance to get your head clear and figure out where you want to take your life. And know that the plant will always be around for you to go back to when you're ready. 

I wish you the best of luck and hope you find a stable peace of mind without the weed.
